name: bifacial
description: Showcase #1, the bifacial world (seed 7): the outline, a crane under the disc, the portal drop to face B and the landing, a drone rise back to the outline. Reproduces v4 (paths/bifacial-v4/plan.json).

shots.note: the outline edge-on from 160 km, a slow push in
an orbit-crane over face A, through edge-on, under to face B (face A's up held)

one take, three parts: s3 first person to the hole and the drop, s4 the motes slowed, s5 a hard cut to the face-B camera (camB, fov, up) as the player rises out and lands. For an upright face-B shot set args.up to "auto"; move the camera with args.camB
a drone rise from shot 5's camera out under the disc and round the rim to the outline; its first keyframe matches s5's camera (change both together)
